traditions.KJV: The words of king Lemuel ,

1.english_reference: the prophecy that his mother taught him

traditions.WLC: מַ֝שָּׂ֗א אֲֽשֶׁר יִסְּרַ֥תּ וּ אִמּֽ וֹ
traditions.VUL: Vísio , qua erudívit eum mater sua .
traditions.KJV: the prophecy that his mother taught him .
What , my son ?

2.english_reference: and what , the son of my womb ?

traditions.KJV: and what , the son of my womb ?

2.english_reference: and what , the son of my vows ?

traditions.KJV: and what , the son of my vows ?

3.english_reference: Give not thy strength unto women

traditions.WLC: אַל תִּתֵּ֣ן לַ נָּשִׁ֣ים חֵילֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.KJV: Give not thy strength unto women ,

3.english_reference: nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings

traditions.WLC: וּ֝ דְרָכֶ֗י ךָ לַֽ מְח֥וֹת מְלָכִֽין
traditions.VUL: et divítias tuas ad deléndos reges .
traditions.KJV: nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings .

4.english_reference: [ It is ] not for kings , O Lemuel , [ it is ] not for kings to drink wine

traditions.WLC: אַ֤ל לַֽ מְלָכִ֨ים לְֽמוֹאֵ֗ל אַ֣ל לַֽ מְלָכִ֣ים שְׁתוֹ יָ֑יִן
traditions.VUL: Noli régibus , o Lámuel , noli régibus dare vinum ,
traditions.KJV: [ It is ] not for kings , O Lemuel , [ it is ] not for kings to drink wine ;
nor for princes strong drink :

traditions.VUL: quia nullum secrétum est ubi regnat ebríetas :

5.english_reference: Lest they drink , and forget the law

traditions.VUL: et ne forte bibant , et obliviscántur iudiciórum ,
traditions.KJV: Lest they drink , and forget the law ,

5.english_reference: and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted

traditions.WLC: וִֽ֝ ישַׁנֶּה דִּ֣ין כָּל בְּנֵי עֹֽנִי
traditions.KJV: and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted .

6.english_reference: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish

traditions.KJV: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish ,

6.english_reference: and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts

traditions.VUL: et vinum his , qui amáro sunt ánimo :
traditions.KJV: and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts .

7.english_reference: Let him drink , and forget his poverty

traditions.KJV: Let him drink , and forget his poverty ,

7.english_reference: and remember his misery no more

traditions.WLC: וַ֝ עֲמָל֗ וֹ לֹ֣א יִזְכָּר עֽוֹד
traditions.VUL: et dolóris sui non recordéntur ámplius .
traditions.KJV: and remember his misery no more .

8.english_reference: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction

traditions.WLC: פְּתַח פִּ֥י ךָ לְ אִלֵּ֑ם אֶל דִּ֝֗ין כָּל בְּנֵ֥י חֲלֽוֹף
traditions.VUL: Aperi os tuum muto , et causis ómnium filiórum qui pertránseunt :
traditions.KJV: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction .
Open thy mouth ,
judge righteously ,

9.english_reference: and plead the cause of the poor and needy

traditions.KJV: and plead the cause of the poor and needy .

10.english_reference: Who can find a virtuous woman ?

traditions.KJV: Who can find a virtuous woman ?

10.english_reference: for her price [ is ] far above rubies

traditions.WLC: וְ רָחֹ֖ק מִ פְּנִינִ֣ים מִכְרָֽ הּ
traditions.VUL: procul et de últimis fínibus prétium eius .
traditions.KJV: for her price [ is ] far above rubies .

11.english_reference: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her

traditions.WLC: בָּ֣טַח בָּ֭ הּ לֵ֣ב בַּעְלָ֑ הּ
traditions.VUL: Confídit in ea cor viri sui ,
traditions.KJV: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her ,

11.english_reference: so that he shall have no need of spoil

traditions.KJV: so that he shall have no need of spoil .

12.english_reference: She will do him good and not evil

traditions.WLC: גְּמָלַ֣תְ הוּ ט֣וֹב וְ לֹא רָ֑ע
traditions.VUL: Reddet ei bonum , et non malum ,
traditions.KJV: She will do him good and not evil

12.english_reference: all the days of her life

traditions.KJV: all the days of her life .
She seeketh wool , and flax ,

13.english_reference: and worketh willingly with her hands

traditions.WLC: וַ֝ תַּ֗עַשׂ בְּ חֵ֣פֶץ כַּפֶּֽי הָ
traditions.VUL: et operáta est consílio mánuum suárum .
traditions.KJV: and worketh willingly with her hands .

14.english_reference: She is like the merchants ’ ships

traditions.KJV: She is like the merchants ’ ships ;

14.english_reference: she bringeth her food from afar

traditions.KJV: she bringeth her food from afar .

15.english_reference: She riseth also while it is yet night

traditions.KJV: She riseth also while it is yet night ,

15.english_reference: and giveth meat to her household

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּתֵּ֣ן טֶ֣רֶף לְ בֵיתָ֑ הּ
traditions.KJV: and giveth meat to her household ,

15.english_reference: and a portion to her maidens

traditions.KJV: and a portion to her maidens .

16.english_reference: She considereth a field , and buyeth it

traditions.KJV: She considereth a field , and buyeth it :

16.english_reference: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard

traditions.WLC: מִ פְּרִ֥י כַ֝פֶּ֗י הָ נטע כָּֽרֶם
traditions.VUL: de fructu mánuum suárum plantávit víneam .
traditions.KJV: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard .

17.english_reference: She girdeth her loins with strength

traditions.KJV: She girdeth her loins with strength ,
and strengtheneth her arms .

18.english_reference: She perceiveth that her merchandise [ is ] good

traditions.VUL: Gustávit , et vidit quia bona est negotiátio eius :
traditions.KJV: She perceiveth that her merchandise [ is ] good :

18.english_reference: her candle goeth not out by night

traditions.WLC: לֹֽא יִכְבֶּ֖ה ב ליל נֵרָֽ הּ
traditions.VUL: non exstinguétur in nocte lucérna eius .
traditions.KJV: her candle goeth not out by night .

19.english_reference: She layeth her hands to the spindle

traditions.KJV: She layeth her hands to the spindle ,

19.english_reference: and her hands hold the distaff

traditions.KJV: and her hands hold the distaff .

20.english_reference: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor

traditions.KJV: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor ;

20.english_reference: yea , she reacheth forth her hands to the needy

traditions.WLC: וְ֝ יָדֶ֗י הָ שִׁלְּחָ֥ה לָֽ אֶבְיֽוֹן
traditions.VUL: et palmas suas exténdit ad páuperem .
traditions.KJV: yea , she reacheth forth her hands to the needy .

21.english_reference: She is not afraid of the snow for her household

traditions.WLC: לֹא תִירָ֣א לְ בֵיתָ֣ הּ מִ שָּׁ֑לֶג
traditions.VUL: Non timébit dómui suæ a frigóribus nivis :
traditions.KJV: She is not afraid of the snow for her household :

21.english_reference: for all her household [ are ] clothed with scarlet

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י כָל בֵּ֝יתָ֗ הּ לָבֻ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים
traditions.VUL: omnes enim doméstici eius vestíti sunt duplícibus .
traditions.KJV: for all her household [ are ] clothed with scarlet .

22.english_reference: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry

traditions.KJV: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry ;

22.english_reference: her clothing [ is ] silk and purple

traditions.KJV: her clothing [ is ] silk and purple .

23.english_reference: Her husband is known in the gates

traditions.KJV: Her husband is known in the gates ,

23.english_reference: when he sitteth among the elders of the land

traditions.WLC: בְּ֝ שִׁבְתּ֗ וֹ עִם זִקְנֵי אָֽרֶץ
traditions.KJV: when he sitteth among the elders of the land .

24.english_reference: She maketh fine linen , and selleth [ it ]

traditions.KJV: She maketh fine linen , and selleth [ it ] ;

24.english_reference: and delivereth girdles unto the merchant

traditions.KJV: and delivereth girdles unto the merchant .

25.english_reference: Strength and honour [ are ] her clothing

traditions.KJV: Strength and honour [ are ] her clothing ;

25.english_reference: and she shall rejoice in time to come

traditions.KJV: and she shall rejoice in time to come .

26.english_reference: She openeth her mouth with wisdom

traditions.KJV: She openeth her mouth with wisdom ;

26.english_reference: and in her tongue [ is ] the law of kindness

traditions.WLC: וְ תֽוֹרַת חֶ֝֗סֶד עַל לְשׁוֹנָֽ הּ
traditions.VUL: et lex cleméntiæ in lingua eius .
traditions.KJV: and in her tongue [ is ] the law of kindness .

27.english_reference: She looketh well to the ways of her household

traditions.KJV: She looketh well to the ways of her household ,

27.english_reference: and eateth not the bread of idleness

traditions.KJV: and eateth not the bread of idleness .

28.english_reference: Her children arise up , and call her blessed

traditions.WLC: קָ֣מוּ בָ֭נֶי הָ וַֽ יְאַשְּׁר֑וּ הָ
traditions.VUL: Surrexérunt fílii eius , et beatíssimam prædicavérunt :
traditions.KJV: Her children arise up , and call her blessed ;

28.english_reference: her husband [ also ] , and he praiseth her

traditions.KJV: her husband [ also ] , and he praiseth her .
Many daughters have done virtuously ,

traditions.WLC: וְ֝ אַ֗תְּ עָלִ֥ית עַל כֻּלָּֽ נָה
traditions.KJV: but thou excellest them all .

30.english_reference: Favour [ is ] deceitful , and beauty [ is ] vain

traditions.WLC: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭ חֵן וְ הֶ֣בֶל הַ יֹּ֑פִי
traditions.VUL: Fallax grátia , et vana est pulchritúdo :
traditions.KJV: Favour [ is ] deceitful , and beauty [ is ] vain : [ but ]

30.english_reference: a woman [ that ] feareth the LORD , she shall be praised

traditions.KJV: a woman [ that ] feareth the LORD , she shall be praised .

31.english_reference: Give her of the fruit of her hands

traditions.WLC: תְּנוּ לָ֭ הּ מִ פְּרִ֣י יָדֶ֑י הָ
traditions.VUL: Date ei de fructu mánuum suárum ,
traditions.KJV: Give her of the fruit of her hands ;

31.english_reference: and let her own works praise her in the gates

traditions.WLC: וִֽ יהַלְל֖וּ הָ בַ שְּׁעָרִ֣ים מַעֲשֶֽׂי הָ
traditions.VUL: et laudent eam in portis ópera eius .
traditions.KJV: and let her own works praise her in the gates .
